cleanTitle: Bishop Nathanyel shows why suicide is prevalent in the Black community 🔥🔥
segments: Why do scriptures speak against suicide
and why are so many of our brothers
opting to directly and indirectly commit
suicide?
Okay. Well,
I'll just quote it and paraphrase. When
you read Deuteronomy 28:28,
one of the curses of God is that we
would be smitten with madness, which
means psychological problems. Why? It
wouldn't happen it wouldn't go boom.
We were brought up under a system, this
American white man, European white man.
We were brought up under their
teachings, their guidance of what beauty
is, that's number one.
We believe the standard for beauty is
the white man and white woman.
That's the standard. And out of many of
our sons and daughters grow up with many
psychological hang-ups. Many
dark-skinned brothers say, "I don't want
no blacky girlfriend. She too black."
The girls do the same thing. "Out of
here, you too dark. You were black. Your
hair's nappy."
